post.description:
Trade a Discord OAuth2 code for a dashboard session.

Keep the returned token on the dashboard's server, never in the browser.
Sign out and revoke the user's Discord tokens. Blacklisted users may too.

get.description: List the guilds the signed-in user manages, with or without the bot.
Get a guild's bear trap.

put.description:
Set a guild's bear trap channel. A `null` channel turns the trap off.

The bot posts the trap message in the channel. If it can't, it turns the trap off again. The trap soft-bans
whoever posts there, so the caller needs Ban Members as well as managing the guild.
